faqs.question: How do I buy or swap $LVAIR?
faqs.answer: Click 'Launch DEX App', connect your Web3 wallet (MetaMask, Phantom, Binance, etc.), enter the amount of USDT you wish to swap, and confirm the transaction. Your $LVAIR tokens will appear in your wallet immediately.

faqs.question: Who controls my tokens and wallet?
faqs.answer: You do. LVAIR Protocol is 100% non-custodial. We never store, manage, or have access to your private keys or funds.

faqs.question: How can I claim the 250 $LVAIR Airdrop?
faqs.answer: Open the DEX App, switch to the 'Airdrop' tab with your connected wallet, and click 'Claim 250 $LVAIR'. Each unique wallet address is entitled to one claim during the genesis distribution phase.
